name: NEOTech
old_description: NEOTech specializes in advanced PCBA manufacturing, with a focus on low-to-medium volume, high-mix designs for complex, high-reliability electronics.
about:
NEOTech is headquartered in Longmont, Colorado. The company operates as a portfolio company of Arkview Capital, a private equity firm. While its founding year is not publicly disclosed, NEOTech has grown through acquisitions, including the purchase of Virtex, to become a multi-site electronics manufacturing services provider.

The company specializes in advanced printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) for low-to-medium volume, high-mix programs that demand high reliability. Its core services span electronic manufacturing services, microelectronics assembly, engineering design, box and system build, and design-for-test and design-for-fabrication support. NEOTech emphasizes supply chain management and operates strategically located facilities to deliver end-to-end manufacturing from concept to customer.

NEOTech serves aerospace and defense, medical equipment, high-tech industrial, digital media, energy, and telecommunications markets. Its customer base includes prime defense contractors such as Northrop Grumman, leading aviation OEMs, and manufacturers of digital projector products using TI DLP technology. The firm also supports connected device development for the Internet of Things sector.

NEOTech differentiates itself by combining Tier 1 capabilities with the agility of a partner-focused organization. It holds ISO 9001, AS9100, ISO 13485, and ITAR registrations, and has achieved CMMC Level 2 certification. The company positions its microelectronics expertise in size, weight, and power (SWaP) reduction and its engineering design resources as key accelerators for customer time-to-market.
